name: Mohammad Rasoulof

films.title: A Man of Integrity
films.overview: Reza, residing in the wilderness with his wife and son, lives a retired life and devotes himself to freshwater fish farming. A private company that has targets on his land is ready to do anything to force him to sell.

films.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
films.overview: Investigating judge Iman grapples with paranoia amid political unrest in Tehran. When his gun vanishes, he suspects his wife and daughters, imposing draconian measures that strain family ties as societal rules crumble.

films.title: There Is No Evil
films.overview: Set against the backdrop of Iran's strict and oppressive legal system, this anthology film tells the stories of four men who each face a moral crisis when having to deal with death penalties.

known_for: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
